name: notification-banner
opens_with: /voice (clear any boot notice), then /copy with no assistant message to copy
notes: The toast counterpart to the error modal: same notification queue, Warning kind instead of Error, suppressed whenever is_modal_open(app) is true (render/mod.rs:437). The leading /voice is load-bearing, not decorative — it REPLACES a boot-time voice_mode_notice with a fresh invisible state, which is the only way to get any_modal_open to false on a host with a working audio device. Without it this scenario fails on every audio-capable machine and passes on every silent one, which is exactly the kind of host-dependent gate that erodes trust in a visual corpus. Worth noting for the product: /voice silently hiding a visible notice (rather than dismissing it) is arguably its own bug. The not-contains side of the needles is what proves the banner is a distinct surface from the status row rather than the same text arriving twice.
